description: A3TI finds the player's UAV seat with (UAVControl _uav) find player (or find _unit) and reads the next element as the role, in fn_getCurrentControlledUnit and fn_getPlayerTurret. A player who is connected to a UAV but not in control of it is not in that array, so find returns -1, the role read returns the first controller object, and toLower throws 'Type Object, expected String' every frame. Treat a missing player as no UAV seat so the function falls back to the player or Zeus unit. Remove this manifest when A3TI guards the lookup.
